headline: 34-trade ledger at -1.06 bps/bet net; latest 13-bet window -15.1 bps — marginal signal still soft on a modest sample.
alert_message: Net negative across 34 resolved trades and the recent 13-bet window; gross edge running below breakeven. Sample still modest — keep monitoring, no pause warranted yet.
regime_note: BTC ~$75.7k, still chopping across the mid-$70s to mid-$80s with sharp two-sided 5-min swings — the volatile tape this fade is built for, so soft results can't be blamed on a 'wrong regime'. No signal active now.
assessment_md:
**How it's doing:** Essentially unchanged from last check. The full ledger now shows 34 resolved trades at **-1.06 bps/bet** net (total **-35.9 bps**), winning just **38%** of the time. The most recent 13-bet window is **-15.1 bps** net (gross -12.1, cost 3.0), with a 46% win rate.

**What changed:** Little. The prior read was the same 34-trade ledger and a near-identical soft window. No new resolved trades have shifted the picture — this is continuity, not fresh deterioration.

**What the numbers do say:** Working backward, gross edge is running around **+2 bps/bet** on the ledger — positive, but below the ~4 bps we hoped for and clearly under the ~3.9 bps breakeven cost. So after realistic costs it is **net slightly negative** so far. The recent window is worse, with even gross turning negative.

**What they don't say:** 34 trades is still a modest sample for a signal whose entire expected edge is a few bps. A handful of the 25–50 bps winners (and losers) dominate the total, so the mean is noisy. This is **not** enough to declare the edge dead, nor to claim it works.

**Bottom line:** Consistent with the pre-registered warning that this signal is marginal and likely not net-profitable after costs. No evidence of a working edge; no evidence of a dramatic collapse either. Stay on **watch**, keep collecting data, and do not expect profit.
